Subject: Update on Your Department Budget Request

Dear [Name],

Thank you for submitting your request for a budget increase. After careful review, we are unable to approve the request at this time, as the current justification does not fully align with our company’s financial strategy.

However, we are open to reconsidering this if you can provide a more detailed explanation along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits. Please feel free to resubmit your proposal with this additional information.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.
